author: 3owj
content: Added --resume flag to 'csnotes process'. In main.rs dispatch: if resume=true, delegates immediately to recover::run(RecoverArgs { resume: true, discard: false }) before acquiring any locks, avoiding lock reentrance. Added resume: bool field to Command::Process variant with #[arg(long)] and help text. No changes to ProcessArgs, process.rs, or recover.rs — recover's existing --resume logic handles both report-present (teardown) and report-absent (re-enter AI) cases. 237 tests, no warnings.
